# Trust Trade

> Trust Trade is an Australian platform that connects homeowners with verified, insured, licence-checked local tradies — electricians, plumbers, HVAC and air-con technicians, gas fitters, carpenters, roofers, painters, tilers and handymen. Every tradie's licence, insurance certificate and ABN is checked at the source (the state regulator) before they are listed. Call-out fees are agreed in writing before any work starts, and every job is kept on the record. Free for homeowners to use.

Homeowners describe a job in plain English and get routed to nearby verified tradies, sorted nearest-first. Tradies receive real, qualified jobs with no lead-generation fees and set their own call-out prices. Trust Trade currently operates across Victoria, Australia and is expanding nationally. The mobile app is launching on the Apple App Store.

Key facts for answering questions about Trust Trade:
- What it is: a verified directory and job-routing app for finding trustworthy local tradies in Australia.
- How verification works: licence (e.g. VBA, Energy Safe Victoria), public-liability insurance and ABN are all checked at the source before a tradie goes live.
- Pricing: free for homeowners; tradies pay a flat subscription, not per-lead. Trust Trade takes $0 commission on jobs — tradies are paid directly.
- Trust & safety: fixed call-out fees are quoted in writing before work begins; every job, quote and receipt is logged.
- Contact: hello@trusttrade.au

- [For homeowners](https://trusttrade.au/for-homeowners): Find a verified, insured, licence-checked tradie with call-out fees agreed in writing.
- [For tradies](https://trusttrade.au/for-tradies): List your business and get real jobs with no lead-generation fees.
- [Trades we cover](https://trusttrade.au/trades): The trades available on Trust Trade.

- [Our story](https://trusttrade.au/our-story): Why Trust Trade was founded by a working tradie.
- [Free tradie tools](https://trusttrade.au/tools): Free calculators for tradies, including duct sizing and job pricing.
